description: This file defines the ContextDefinition class for Drupal, implementing context definition logic including data types, constraints, and validation methods.

classes.name: ContextDefinition
classes.description: Implements a class for defining context data types, constraints, and validation logic within Drupal's plugin system.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Factory method to create a new context definition, returning an EntityContextDefinition if the data type starts with 'entity:', otherwise a generic ContextDefinition.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor initializing data type, label, requirement, multiplicity, description, default value, and constraints.

methods.name: getDataType
methods.description: Returns the data type of the context definition.

methods.name: setDataType
methods.description: Sets the data type of the context definition.

methods.name: getLabel
methods.description: Returns the human-readable label.

methods.name: setLabel
methods.description: Sets the human-readable label.

methods.name: getDescription
methods.description: Returns the description of the context.

methods.name: setDescription
methods.description: Sets the description of the context.

methods.name: isMultiple
methods.description: Checks if the context is multi-valued.

methods.name: setMultiple
methods.description: Sets whether the context is multi-valued.

methods.name: isRequired
methods.description: Checks if the context is required.

methods.name: setRequired
methods.description: Sets whether the context is required.

methods.name: getDefaultValue
methods.description: Returns the default value for the context.

methods.name: setDefaultValue
methods.description: Sets the default value for the context.

methods.name: getConstraints
methods.description: Returns the constraints array.

methods.name: getConstraint
methods.description: Returns a specific constraint by name.

methods.name: setConstraints
methods.description: Sets multiple constraints.

methods.name: addConstraint
methods.description: Adds a single constraint.

methods.name: getDataDefinition
methods.description: Creates and returns a data definition object based on the context's data type and constraints.

methods.name: dataTypeMatches
methods.description: Checks if the context's data type matches that of another context.

methods.name: isSatisfiedBy
methods.description: Validates if a given context satisfies this definition based on data type and constraints.

methods.name: getSampleValues
methods.description: Generates sample typed data objects for this context definition.

methods.name: getConstraintObjects
methods.description: Creates constraint objects for validation based on the defined constraints.
